name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v551: fixes Cloudflare WebView not appearing on phone or TV. (1) currentActivity() now walks the context chain to find a valid Activity when CommonActivity.activity is unset, so the bypass WebView can always be launched. (2) probeAndResolveIfNeeded always opens the bypass when no saved cookie exists — never fail-open. (3) showCloudflareBypass now calls onCookiesChanged(false) on every failure path so the deferred is always completed. (4) Stale bypass fragments are removed before opening a new one. (5) withContext has invokeOnCancellation to complete the deferred if the coroutine is cancelled. (6) All v550 fixes retained: invisible→visible TV fallback, one-solve-at-a-time, per-host cookies, client hints, empty-UA guard, D-pad cursor bounds.
